importantNotes: 'All Scripture is God-breathed' (3:16) — the foundational statement on the inspiration of Scripture.
'I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race' (4:7) — Paul's triumphant farewell.
'God gave us a spirit not of fear, but of power, love, and self-discipline' (1:7).
This is Paul's last letter — he knows his death is near (4:6).
Paul asks Timothy to bring his cloak and scrolls (4:13) — a touching personal detail.

chapters.1: Fan into flame the gift of God; do not be ashamed of the gospel; guard the deposit.
chapters.2: Be strong in grace; endure hardship like a soldier; a worker who correctly handles the word.
chapters.3: Perilous times will come; continue in what you have learned; all Scripture is God-breathed.
chapters.4: Preach the Word; Paul's farewell — 'I have fought the good fight'; personal requests.
